name: Silvermane Stalker Flank
summary: Silvermane Stalker Flanks are raw meat Agnar Beastamer seeks in the Hinterlands. He needs them to feed a Sprite Darter hatchling.

sections.title: A First Meal
sections.body: Agnar Beastamer is preparing for the egg to hatch, and worries the young Sprite Darter may not survive without a good first meal. He asks you to bring five Silvermane Stalker Flanks. The meat is meant for the hatchling when it emerges.

faq.answer: Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands wants five Silvermane Stalker Flanks to feed a Sprite Darter hatchling.
Agnar plans to feed the raw meat to a Sprite Darter when its egg hatches.

faq.q: How many flanks does Agnar need?
faq.answer: Agnar Beastamer asks you to bring five Silvermane Stalker Flanks.

faq.q: Where do Silvermane Stalker Flanks come from?
faq.answer: Silvermane Stalker Flanks come from Silvermane Stalkers in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What does a Sprite Darter eat?
faq.answer: Sprite Darters eat both meat and vegetation. Agnar asks for raw Silvermane Stalker Flanks as a first meal for the hatchling.
